name: Tamil Nadu
summary: Home to one of the world's oldest surviving classical civilizations and languages. Masterpieces of Dravidian temple architecture (Great Living Chola Temples), automobile capital of India ('Detroit of South Asia').
festivals: Pongal (Thai Pongal, Jallikattu), Karthigai Deepam, Chithirai Festival (Madurai)
monuments: Brihadisvara Temple Thanjavur (Big Temple, UNESCO), Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram (UNESCO), Meenakshi Amman Temple Madurai
nationalParks: Guindy National Park, Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park, Mudumalai National Park, Mukurthi
schemes: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam, Pudhumai Penn Scheme, Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme

mcqs.q: The Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur, celebrated for its 80-tonne granite monolithic cupola, was built by which Chola monarch?
mcqs.exp: Rajaraja Chola I completed the world's first complete granite temple in 1010 AD.

mcqs.q: Which classical dance form originated in the temples of Tamil Nadu, formerly known as Sadir or Dasi Attam?
mcqs.exp: Bharatanatyam is rooted in Natya Shastra by Bharata Muni and was preserved and refined by Devadasis in Tamil temples.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Tamil Nadu.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Chennai. Tamil Nadu covers a geographic area of 130,058 sq km across 38 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Cauvery, Vaigai, Thamirabarani, Palar.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Home to one of the world's oldest surviving classical civilizations and languages. Masterpieces of Dravidian temple architecture (Great Living Chola Temples), automobile capital of India ('Detroit of South Asia').

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Tamil Nadu.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Tamil Nadu was formally instituted on 26 January 1950. Official language(s): Tamil (Classical Language).

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Bharatanatyam (Classical Dance), Karagattam, Mayil Attam.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Pongal (Thai Pongal, Jallikattu), Karthigai Deepam, Chithirai Festival (Madurai).

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Tamil Nadu.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is R. N. Ravi.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu is M. K. Stalin.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Madras High Court (Chennai).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Nilgiri tahr | State Bird: Emerald dove | State Flower: Gloriosa lily (Kanthal) | State Tree: Palmyra palm.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Tamil Nadu.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Lignite (Neyveli), Magnesite (Salem), Bauxite, Limestone.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Tamil Nadu plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Tamil Nadu.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Brihadisvara Temple Thanjavur (Big Temple, UNESCO), Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram (UNESCO), Meenakshi Amman Temple Madurai.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Guindy National Park, Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park, Mudumalai National Park, Mukurthi.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Tamil Nadu.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam, Pudhumai Penn Scheme, Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme.
